en: Letter from R. P. N. Morris to Thomas S. Gathright, June 23, 1879
This letter is to Thomas S. Gathright from R. P. N. Morris regarding a report of the final examination of different classes and equipment in the Natural Philosophy and Experiment department.
From Box 1, Folder 5, 'Correspondence. June 1879' in the Thomas S. Gathright Letters collection at Cushing Memorial Library and Archives.
Agricultural and Mechanical College of Texas
Report of the Department of Natural Philosophy and Experiment
Provided by Texas A&M University Libraries
